description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject, which extends HTMLPurifier_Injector to add security features for object and param HTML elements, ensuring safe embedding of objects by adding and validating parameters.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_Injector to add security parameters to object tags and validate parameters within object and param tags.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the injector with configuration and context, calling the parent prepare method.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handles 'object' and 'param' elements, adding security parameters to 'object' tags and validating 'param' tags.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of 'object' tags, managing internal stacks.
